## Watch now – 8 min video


Zorba is the modern SFR investment platform for institutional investors, allowing them to source, acquire, renovate, lease, and manage single-family rentals all from one place with streamlined workflows powered by AI.


Explore the Zorba platform by watching our on-demand webinar by Brandon LaVallee, our Director of Strategic Partnerships.


Learn more at:[https://www.getzorba.com](https://www.getzorba.com/)
